spans.s: शुश्रू f. A mother.
शुश्रूषक m. A servant, an attendant.
शुश्रूषण n. 1. Desire to hear; 2. obedience; 3. service, attendance.
शुश्रूषणा f. 1. Desire to hear; 2. obedience; 3. service, attendance.
शुश्रूषा f. 1. Desire to hear; 2. service, attendance; 3. obedience; 4. telling, narrating.
शुश्रूषु a. 1. Desirous of hearing; 2. ready to serve; 3. obedient.
शुष् vi. 4P (pp. शुष्क; pres. शुष्यति) 1. To become dry; 2. to be withered.With परि-, to dry up, to wither, to pine.With सम्-, to be dried up.
शूष् vt. 1P (pres. शूषति) 1. To beget; 2. to bring forth.
सूष् vt. 1P (pres. सूषति) To bring forth, to bear, to beget.
शुष m. 1. A hole in the ground; 2. drying up.
शुषी f. 1. A hole in the ground; 2. drying up.
शुषि f. 1. Drying up; 2. a hole; 3. the hollow in the fang of a snake.
सुषि f. A hole. Cf. शुषि.
शुषिर (I) m. 1. Fire; 2. a mouse.
शुषिर (II) n. 1. The atmosphere; 2. a hole; 3. a wind-instrument.
शुषिरा f. 1. A river; 2. a kind of perfume.
सुषिर (I) a. (f. रा) Having apertures or holes.
सुषिर (II) n. 1. An aperture, opening; 2. a wind-instrument.
सुषिर (I) a. (f. रा) Having apertures or holes.
शुषिल m. Air, wind.
सुशीला f. 1. An epithet of the wife of Yama; 2. name of one of Kṛṣṇa’s eight favourite wives.

शुष्क a. (f. ष्का) 1. Dried up, dry, M.xi.155; 2. emaciated, withered; 3. groundless, causeless; 4. feigned, हारि शुष्करुदितं च सुखेति Sis.x.69; 5. offensive, तस्मै नाकुशलं ब्रूयोन्न शुष्कां गिरमीरयेत् M.xi.85; 6. unproductive, unprofitable.

शुष्क a. (f. ष्का) 1. Dried up, dry, M.xi.155; 2. emaciated, withered; 3. groundless, causeless; 4. feigned, हारि शुष्करुदितं च सुखेति Sis.x.69; 5. offensive, तस्मै नाकुशलं ब्रूयोन्न शुष्कां गिरमीरयेत् M.xi.85; 6. unproductive, unprofitable.
शुष्क-अंगी f. a lizard.
शुष्क-अन्न n. rice in the husk.
शुष्क-कलह m. useless quarrelling.
शुष्क-वैर n. groundless enmity.
शुष्कल m.n. 1. Dried flesh; 2. flesh in general.
शुष्म (I) m. 1. The sun; 2. fire; 3. wind; 4. bird.
शुष्म (II) n. 1. Light, lustre; 2. energy, prowess.
सुष्म n. A rope, a cord.
शुष्मन् (I) m. Fire.
शुष्मन् (II) n. 1. Light, lustre; 2. prowess.
सुशंस a. (f. सा) Well-spoken of, praiseworthy, glorious.
सुशंस a. (f. सा) Well-spoken of, praiseworthy, glorious.
सुशक a. (f. का) Capable of being easily done.
सुशक a. (f. का) Capable of being easily done.
सुशिक्षित a. (f. ता) Well-trained, well-disciplined.
सुशिक्षित a. (f. ता) Well-trained, well-disciplined.
सुशिखा f. 1. A peacock’s crest; 2. a cock’s comb.
सुश्रुत m. Name of the author of a system of medicine. His work, named after him, together with that of Charaka, is regarded as the oldest medical authority in India.
सुश्लिष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) Well-arranged, well-fitted.
सुश्लिष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) Well-arranged, well-fitted.
सुषम a. (f. मा) Lovely, beautiful.
सुषम a. (f. मा) Lovely, beautiful.
सुषमा f. 1. Exquisite beauty; 2. great refulgence, इंदोश्च बिंबमसमां सुषमामयासीत् Bh.V.iii.7.
सुषवी f. 1. A sort of gourd; 2. black cumin.
सुषाढ m. An epithet of Śiva.
सुषि(षी)म (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Cold, frigid; 2. pleasant, agreeable.
सुषि(षी)म (II) m. 1. Cold; 2. species of snake; 3. the moon-gem.
सुषि(षी)म (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Cold, frigid; 2. pleasant, agreeable.
सुषि(षी)म (II) m. 1. Cold; 2. species of snake; 3. the moon-gem.
सुषि(षी)म (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Cold, frigid; 2. pleasant, agreeable.
सुषुप्ति f. 1. Deep sleep, profound repose; 2. spiritual ignorance, अविद्यात्मिका हि सा महासुषुप्तिर्यस्यां स्वरूपप्रतिबोधरहिताः शेरते संसारिणो जीवाः S.Bh.i.4.
सुषुम्णा f. A particular artery of the body lying between the vessels called इडा and पिंगला.
सुष्ठु ind. 1. Well, excellently, beautifully; 2. much, very, सुष्ठु शोभसे विनयेन Ut.i.; 3. truly, e.g. अथवा सुष्ठु खल्विदमुच्यते.
सुसन्नत a. (f. ता) Well-directed (as an arrow).
सुसन्नत a. (f. ता) Well-directed (as an arrow).
सुसह (I) a. (f. हा) 1. Easy to be borne; 2. bearing or enduring well.
सुसह (II) m. An epithet of Śiva.
सुसह (I) a. (f. हा) 1. Easy to be borne; 2. bearing or enduring well.
सुसार (I) a. (f. रा) Having good essence.
सुसार (II) m. 1. Good essence, good substance; 2. competence; 3. the red flowering Khadira.
सुसार (I) a. (f. रा) Having good essence.
सुस्थ (I) a. (f. स्था) 1. Well-situated, being in a good condition; 2. in health, healthy; 3. faring well, prosperous, well off; 4. happy.
सुस्थ (II) n. A happy condition, e.g. सुस्थे को वा न पंडितः.
सुस्थ (I) a. (f. स्था) 1. Well-situated, being in a good condition; 2. in health, healthy; 3. faring well, prosperous, well off; 4. happy.
सुस्थिति f. 1. Good condition, well-being, welfare; 2. health, convalescence.
सुस्मिता f. A woman with a smiling or pleasing countenance.
सूषणा f. A mother.
सूष्यंती f. A woman who is parturient.
